description: The real neighbourhood out to about 27 light-years, as Starman Reborn's sky snapshot of 2026-09-30 holds it: stars from Gaia DR3 and SIMBAD, known planets from the NASA Exoplanet Archive and the Extrasolar Planets Encyclopaedia, belts and debris discs from the papers SIMBAD links. Positions are Sol-centred equatorial Cartesian light-years at epoch J2016.0. The lanes are fiction: Reborn’s jump network, which in Control is the catalogue of old lanes from before the Lapse.

belts.note: The main asteroid belt lies between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter.
